method: Built-in image generation; original whole-body animation atlas. Reference: prior project Flint illustrated frames.
prompt: Create an original production sprite atlas for Urban Fracture. Use the reference only for the identity and illustrated art style of Flint: stocky muscular adult man, short dark hair, dark mustache, orange prison jumpsuit with rolled sleeves, white undershirt, dark brown work boots. Crisp illustrated comic realism, matching the reference, consistent human anatomy and proportions. Transparent background. Exactly 16 separate COMPLETE BODY frames, uniform 4 columns by 4 rows, wide padding between cells, no overlap, no text, no shadows, no scenery. Every frame faces RIGHT and stays grounded on the same sole baseline in its cell. Rows 1 and 2 are eight successive frames of a fast standing right cross punch: guarded stance, windup, shoulder turn, fist extending, full fist contact at chest height, followthrough, retract, guarded stance. Rows 3 and 4 are eight successive frames of a standing front kick: guard, weight shift, right knee lift, lower leg extending, full boot contact at abdomen height, knee retract, right foot placing, guard. The left foot remains planted throughout the front kick. Actual frame by frame limbs, no floating, no double legs, no batons or other weapons. Preserve face, outfit and head size across all 16 frames. Full figures including boots and hands must fit entirely within their cells. This is a game animation asset sheet, not a character poster.
